claims.text: The 2000 PET experiment enrolled eight highly hypnotizable participants.
The Harvard interview reported 125 people initially screened; that number is NOT the trial sample.
Under hypnosis, left/right color-responsive activity followed verbal color/gray instruction.
Left-side result differed from right-side result in nonhypnotized conditions.
PET blood flow is not a direct readout of an individual's private conscious perception.
Kirsch criticized differences in instructions between hypnotized and nonhypnotized conditions.
Hypnosis has no single settled theory of mechanism.
Franklin's 1784 commission examined Deslon's magnetic-fluid claims, not every practice of Mesmer.
Puységur historical case records include failed predictions and ethical disputes.
The 2000 color-perception experiment demonstrates Zen12 efficacy.
A 2023 review of 14 binaural beat EEG studies found 5 supportive, 8 contradictory and 1 mixed result.
Binaural-beat effects in EEG are equivalent to a specific customer cognitive benefit.
Inspire3 publicly lists the Zen12 meditation program.
Zen12 seller describes 12 levels and four styles of audio per level.
Complete Zen12 package is advertised as 48 MP3 files.
Zen12 offers sessions described as twelve minutes.
One-hour meditation equivalence in twelve minutes is independently proven.
Zen12 2026-11-12 public catalog displayed a different promotional total than its checkout snapshot.
The Zen12 checkout says it offers a one-year money-back guarantee.
Actual Zen12 refunds are independently verified to arrive.
Hypnosis Live Total Focus seller specifies an audio session of 33 minutes and 47 MB.
Total Focus seller advertises a 14-day refund period.
Brainwave Shots Focus Shot seller lists 15- and 30-minute versions.
Focus Shot seller advertises a one-year refund guarantee.
Total Focus or Focus Shot measurably enhances concentration for customers.
The Inspire3 public affiliate recruitment page proves FV publisher acceptance.
A consumer Inspire3 email reporting approved waiting-list access proves an affiliate relationship.
An affiliate disclosure placed near a recommendation is required when earning links exist.
Psychological health outcomes can be promoted without product-specific substantiation.
A click on a merchant link establishes a paid commission.
The live Focus page is a free resource, not paid conversion proof.
Public search failure proves FV has no product in its Payhip account.
Private checkout and product rights require inventory owner review before a paid FV offer is marketed.
